What the heck does 11B / A mean?
It means you're in the key of A. The 11B refers to Camelot. You should probably already know that. That's okay, search for "Camelot Wheel" and all will become clear!

Basically, it's a wheel that you use to see what keys work in conjunction to other keys.

See here:

https://produtique.com/camelot-wheel/

Now, you can go from in to out AND you can go clockwise or clockwise - after you go in or out. So, if you 12A you can go to 12B, you can go to 11A or 1A, but you can't go to 11B or 1B (or it will be dissonant/displeasing to the ear).

So, you can go 12A to 1A and then go to 1B, but you can't go 12A to 1B.

They're simple guides but effective.
